hero.title: Martin Novák
hero.subtitle: Multimedia Creator & Storyteller
hero.description: I blend creative vision with cutting-edge technology to deliver multimedia experiences that captivate, engage, and inspire. Specializing in cinematography, motion graphics, and visual storytelling.

about.subtitle: About Me
about.title: Creative Multimedia Professional
about.bio1: I'm a passionate multimedia student with expertise in video production, motion graphics, and digital content creation. With a keen eye for visual storytelling, I transform creative ideas into compelling multimedia experiences.
about.bio2: My work spans across commercial campaigns, independent films, and creative projects. I specialize in cinematography, video editing, color grading, and visual effects.
about.bio3: When I'm not creating, you'll find me exploring new technologies, experimenting with emerging tools, and constantly pushing the boundaries of multimedia production.
